value.rationale: The four canonical degree-seven arrangements encode a complex Zariski pair. Their literal equality in characteristic seven is a structurally motivated arithmetic boundary, accompanied by a complete global singular-support and local-contact classification of all four models through every prime at least seven. The classification links arithmetic degeneration to distinguished complex realization components and distinguishes three different collision mechanisms, not an arbitrary finite enumeration or merely a known quadratic discriminant.
